$comentario: The Settings screen. The printed template's text does NOT go here —the document's language is not the screen's (RN-29)— but each template's NAME does, because it is chosen from here.
settings_description: The business details, the currency, the tax and how what you print looks.
settings_trade_name_hint: This is the one shown in the menu and at the top of the document.
settings_legal_name_hint: Only if it differs from the trade name.
settings_locale_hint: What anyone who has not picked another one for their session gets.
settings_document_locale_hint: The invoice is for the customer and for the tax authority, so it does not follow the screen language.
settings_logo_hint: Shown in the menu and on the document. PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 250 KB.
settings_logo_missing: The business has no logo configured.
settings_logo_undecodable: The stored logo could not be decoded.
settings_no_svg: SVGs are not accepted: they are XML and can carry code inside. The logo is served from the same origin as the POS, so only images are accepted.
settings_accent_hint: The shade for the dark theme and the text color are calculated from this one.
settings_accent_chart_warning: This shade does not stand out enough against the chart background, so the bars keep the validated color. The rest of the interface does use it.
settings_currency_hint: Pick one and the rest is filled in. The separators stay editable because the local convention does not always match the standard.
settings_tax_hint: Applied when charging. Returns of earlier sales keep using the rate they were charged with, not this one.
settings_money_preview: This is how amounts will look
settings_template_hint: What gets printed when charging and from each invoice.
$comentario_plantillas: Each template's name and description. The keys are the ids stored in `document.template`: the value is not translated.
settings_template_receipt_description: One column, no colors, meant for the roll in the counter printer. It is what a corner store wants: it comes out in two seconds and uses no ink.
settings_template_classic_description: Full page, a color band with the business name, issuer and customer details facing each other, a plain table and a totals block on the right. Good for sending by email.
settings_template_modern_description: Full page with a diagonal header, the logo up front, a table with a colored head and a contact footer. The same information as the classic one, with more brand presence.
$comentario_monedas: Each currency's name. The key is the ISO 4217 code, which is what gets stored.
settings_document_color_hint: Bands and headers. It does not affect the thermal receipt.
settings_legal_notice_hint: While no electronic invoice is issued, it is worth saying so here.
settings_notes_placeholder: E.g., Exchanges are accepted within 8 days with the invoice.
settings_einvoicing_hint: The issuer's details for the tax authority. They are stored to have them ready; VentaSys does not issue documents yet.
settings_einvoicing_warning_title: It does not issue documents yet.
settings_einvoicing_warning_1: Issuing for real means signing the XML with the business's cryptographic key, sending it to the tax authority and waiting for the acceptance reply. None of that is implemented, so checking this box does not make anything be issued: it only records that the business invoices electronically.
settings_einvoicing_warning_2: The key and its PIN are neither asked for nor stored. Keeping a credential the system does not use is giving away the risk for nothing.
settings_einvoicing_enabled_hint: Changes the document title to «Electronic invoice». It is worth adjusting the legal notice in the Documents tab too.
settings_economic_activity_hint: The 6-digit code registered with the tax authority.
settings_missing_1: The tax authority requires the goods and services classification on every line. The catalog has no such field today.
settings_missing_2: A 20-digit numbering per branch and terminal, and a 50-digit key that includes the ID number and the date.
settings_missing_3: The XML is signed with the taxpayer's cryptographic key. It is the piece that forces handling a secret on the server.
settings_missing_4: It is sent to the tax authority and the acceptance is awaited, which is asynchronous: the status has to be stored and retried.
$comentario_validacion: What the save action replies. It goes here and not in validation.json because these are rules of this screen, not of the validator.
settings_bad_color: {field} has to be a color in #rrggbb format.
settings_logo_bad_type: The logo has to be PNG, JPG or WebP. SVGs are not accepted, for security.
settings_logo_too_big: The logo cannot be larger than {max} KB.
settings_missing_5: If the tax authority does not answer, the sale still has to be chargeable and sent later. A POS cannot sit waiting with the customer standing there.
